name: Captured cookies cannot write across unrelated domains
instruction: Cookie capture accepts Set-Cookie Domain attributes only when the response host is allowed to set that domain, preserving host-only and IP-literal semantics.
relevant_when: TypeScript code that parses Set-Cookie response data, normalizes cookie domains, sets hostOnly flags, or decides whether a cookie domain matches a request host.
context: Recent cookie-jar PR feedback focused on host-only cookies, response-domain capture guards, and IP-literal exact matching so one host cannot store cookies for an unrelated host.
scope_reason: The cookie service or kernel helper file contains the domain normalization and matching logic needed to judge the invariant.

checklist.name: domain-attribute-validated-against-host
checklist.rule: When a response cookie includes a Domain attribute, the code verifies that the request or response host domain-matches that attribute before storing the cookie.

checklist.name: host-only-cookies-stay-host-only
checklist.rule: Cookies without a Domain attribute are marked or handled as host-only so they do not apply to sibling or child domains.

checklist.name: ip-literals-require-exact-domain
checklist.rule: For IP-literal hosts, Domain attributes are accepted only on exact host equality rather than suffix or parent-domain matching.
